File: src/ingest/parser.ts

Update splitFields to treat unescaped quotes in the middle of unquoted fields or as normal characters rather than starting an unclosed quoted section that swallows the rest of the line, or handle unquoted CSV fields correctly when quotes appear without being at the start of a field.
args.title: Fix CSV parsing when unescaped inch marks appear in unquoted fields

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The CSV parser treats any quote character as starting a quoted field even when it appears in the middle of an unquoted field, causing lines with inch marks to consume subsequent characters and fail shape validation.
